title: Trying again.
text: I signed up for this club initially a few weeks ago and received The Wall by Pink Floyd. I already have it on vinyl but my copy is pretty old so I decided to keep it. The remastered copy I received sounded great and I saved a bunch of money on it. When I signed up, though, I expected to receive and email letting me know what the selection of the month was. This is how other clubs I am subscribed to work. Most give you a week to decide whether you want it or not. This did not happen. I just happened to notice that The Wall had been ordered and was on it's way to me. I noticed that next month's selection is London Calling by the Clash. That works for me. Now I really...really hope Amazon changes things and lets me cancel an order if it's something I don't want or already have. Just let me know beforehand and give me time to decide. Or better yet, let me pick from a number selections!
label: neutral
